answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and confined to the primary region during peak settlement, so a regional shift is the closest prior pattern (b2) that can restore availability while continuing to accept writes. Release timing also makes rollback (b1) plausible, so those two records need verification before a hard commit. Circuit breaking is rejected because failing closed on writes would drop customer payments. Scale stays a small guarded test: root cause is still ambiguous among release, regional infra, and peak load, and a full cutover during settlement could create cross-region settlement/downstream value risk.
